trophies.name: Super Mario Bros. 3 Master
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.

trophies.name: Grass Is Greener
trophies.description: Complete World 1.

trophies.name: Deserted and Done
trophies.description: Complete World 2.

trophies.name: Making a Splash
trophies.description: Complete World 3.

trophies.name: Going Giant
trophies.description: Complete World 4.

trophies.name: Head in the Clouds
trophies.description: Complete World 5.

trophies.name: Ice to Meet You
trophies.description: Complete World 6.

trophies.name: Pipe Down
trophies.description: Complete World 7.

trophies.name: Dark and Stormy
trophies.description: Complete World 8 and defeat Bowser.

trophies.name: Stage Presence
trophies.description: Complete every numbered stage in Worlds 1 through 8.

trophies.name: Fortress of Solitude
trophies.description: Complete every Fortress in the game.

trophies.name: Ship Happens
trophies.description: Complete every Koopa airship and defeat all seven Koopalings.

trophies.name: Fleet Street
trophies.description: Complete the Tank, Navy, Air Force, and final Airship stages in World 8.

trophies.name: Map Busters
trophies.description: Defeat every Hammer Brother, Boomerang Brother, Fire Brother, and Piranha Plant encountered on the world maps.

trophies.name: Down Goes the Koopa
trophies.description: Defeat Bowser and rescue Princess Toadstool.

trophies.name: Whistle While You Warp
trophies.description: Collect all three Warp Whistles.

trophies.name: Warp Zone Traveler
trophies.description: Enter the Warp Zone.

trophies.name: White-Hot Secrets
trophies.description: Unlock and visit all seven White Mushroom Houses.

trophies.name: P-Wingman
trophies.description: Obtain every P-Wing awarded by the White Mushroom Houses.

trophies.name: Anchors Away
trophies.description: Obtain every Anchor awarded by the White Mushroom Houses.

trophies.name: Treasure Fleet
trophies.description: Turn every possible Hammer Brother encounter into a Treasure Ship and clear it.

trophies.name: Card Sharp
trophies.description: Complete the card-matching bonus game.

trophies.name: Three of a Kind
trophies.description: Match three identical symbols in the Spade Panel.

trophies.name: Mushroom Match
trophies.description: Match three Mushrooms in the Spade Panel and earn the maximum Mushroom bonus.

trophies.name: Flower Power
trophies.description: Match three Flowers in the Spade Panel and earn the maximum Flower bonus.

trophies.name: Star Struck
trophies.description: Match three Stars in the Spade Panel and earn the maximum Star bonus.

trophies.name: Frog in His Throat
trophies.description: Complete a level while wearing the Frog Suit.

trophies.name: Tanooki Trouble
trophies.description: Complete a level while wearing the Tanooki Suit.

trophies.name: Hammer Time
trophies.description: Complete a level while wearing the Hammer Suit.

trophies.name: Walk a Mile
trophies.description: Find and ride Kuribo's Shoe.

trophies.name: Music to Their Ears
trophies.description: Use a Music Box to put a Hammer Brother or Piranha Plant to sleep on the world map.

trophies.name: Hammer and Away
trophies.description: Use a Hammer to destroy a rock on the world map and reveal a secret path.

trophies.name: Drop Anchor
trophies.description: Use an Anchor to prevent a defeated Koopaling's airship from moving.

trophies.name: Shoe's the Way
trophies.description: Use Kuribo's Shoe to defeat an enemy that cannot normally be defeated by Mario.

trophies.name: Suit Yourself
trophies.description: Defeat a Koopaling while wearing the Frog Suit, Tanooki Suit, or Hammer Suit and receive the special ending message.

trophies.name: Suit Collection
trophies.description: Obtain and use the Frog Suit, Tanooki Suit, and Hammer Suit.

trophies.name: The Long Way Around
trophies.description: Complete the game without using a Warp Whistle.

trophies.name: King of the Eight Worlds
trophies.description: Complete every required stage, fortress, special encounter, secret area, and major collectible in the game.
